title: Centripetal Force Visualization
description: Interactive visualization showing the relationship between velocity, centripetal acceleration, and centripetal force in circular motion. Demonstrates how velocity is tangent to the path while acceleration and force point toward the center.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: physics

centripetal force
centripetal acceleration
velocity
